notes.title: Tower of Grimoiria V 0.1.1 - Bugfixes
notes.content:
Small update featuring some bug fixes:

 Fixed an issue where the player was unable to return if they fell out of the map
 Fixed the player's recall ability
 Fixed windowed mode settings resetting upon loading from the title screen to the game scene
 Fixed an issue where the tutorial was non-functional if the player returned to the title screen after playing a normal game
 Fixed an issue where the sentry shop wouldn't close properly under certain circumstances
 Fixed an issue where the player could continue to move while the sentry shop was open
